description: This Java class defines an immutable implementation of the AclEntry interface, representing an access control list entry with authorization subject and permissions. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters and JSON, validation routines, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: ImmutableAclEntry
classes.description: An immutable implementation of AclEntry, representing an ACL entry with an authorization subject and permissions, including methods for instantiation from JSON and parameters, validation, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new AclEntry instance with a single permission and authorization subject.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new AclEntry instance from an authorization subject and an iterable collection of permissions.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new AclEntry instance from JSON key and value, parsing permissions.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an AclEntry from a JSON object, extracting the first authorization subject and permissions.
